items.title: Illinois Republicans Assess Damage From Nationwide ‘Blue Tsunami’
items.description: In the governor’s race, Gov. JB Pritzker set a modern-day record for a Democratic candidate with about 60% of the vote. And in state legislative races, Republicans lost more seats than expected.

items.title: Devastated Family Of Slain Student Call For Justice At Logan Square Vigil: ‘Santino Is Not A Statistic’
items.description: Santino Delgado’s family and neighbors gathered for a memorial walk a week after the City Colleges student was killed in a drive-by shooting while making a food delivery.

items.title: 3-Hour Waits For Matcha? Here’s The Tea On Chicago’s Obsession
items.description: The trendy tea drink has enjoyed a surge in demand in recent years thanks in part to social media, with long lines at pop-ups and stores like Nichi, Match-A and Noble Fat.

items.title: Ald. Michelle Harris Faces 4 Challengers In 8th Ward Race
items.description: Harris is seeking a sixth term in office and could face four opponents — although two of those candidates could get tossed off the ballot as their nominating petitions were challenged.

items.title: Ald. Monique Scott Faces 2 Challengers In 24th Ward Race
items.description: Jamesenna Anderson and Kiisha Smith have filed to run against Scott, who is seeking her second full term representing the West Side ward.

items.title: Mark Heller, Logan Square Skate Park Founder And Community Activist, Dies At 73
items.description: A celebration of life for Heller will take place 11:30 a.m. Saturday at Logan Boulevard Skate Park.

items.title: ‘The After Hours Artists’ Exhibit Explores How Chicago Creators Balance Art With Day Jobs
items.description: After forming a queer-friendly collective for people pursuing their passions outside of work hours, Nathan Alston curated their work for the show at Austin’s Third City Studio.

items.title: Here’s How To Celebrate Veterans Day Across Chicago Wednesday
items.description: VFWs and American Legion posts hold strong on Veterans Day amid an aging population and declining membership, welcoming the public for drinks, food and camaraderie.
